ache.title: “Urgent tips” for a patch? Breathe, Nero
ache.note: This is about mastering Chain Attacks and the Stun Meter in patch 1.1 to squeeze out more DPS. Learning mechanics is genuinely fun. But framing it as urgent turns play into optimizing, and optimizing is where you start feeling you need the best units to keep up. You don’t have to max anything.
watch: DPS chasing that hints at better units
ache.tip: Learn the tricks that make the game more fun for you, and skip the ones that feel like homework.
lines: nothing about a stun meter is urgent
he said urgent. it was not urgent

textData.text: Urgent and insightful tips on using Chain Attacks and managing the Stun Meter in Zenless Zone Zero. Discover how to maximize DPS by mastering the cancellation of chain attacks, exploiting the shared timer of the rainbow and gray bars, and understanding the benefits of timing your stuns. Nero also reveals the strategic advantage of choosing chain direction and character sequences for optimal performance. This video is packed with essential tactics to enhance your gameplay with characters like Anby, Ellen, and Soukaku in patch 1.1.
